---
title: "03_describe"
format: html
---

Library
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
```

Load the clean data
```{r}
clean_data <- read_tsv(file = "../data/02_dat_clean.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

Make new column - 'smoker':
"former" - used to smoke but quit
"never" - never smoked
"current" - active smoker
```{r}
clean_data <- clean_data |>
  mutate(smoker = case_when(
    packyrs == 0 & yrsquit == 0 ~ "never",
    packyrs != 0 & yrsquit != 0 ~ "former",
    packyrs != 0 & yrsquit == 0 ~ "current"
  )) |>
  relocate(smoker, .after = yrsquit)
```

Save augmented data
```{r}
write_tsv(x = clean_data, file = "../data/03_dat_aug.tsv")
```
